entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE
entities.description: Substate where the UE is registered but not allowed to access normal services.

entities.name: eCall inactivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed by UE configured for eCall only mode when timers T3444 or T3445 expire.

entities.name: T3444
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: T3445
entities.description: Timer whose expiry triggers eCall inactivity procedure in eCall only mode.

entities.name: eCall only mode configured
entities.description: Condition where UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102.

relations.description: UE in NON-ALLOWED-SERVICE substate requires eCall only mode configuration to perform eCall inactivity procedure.
eCall only mode configuration establishes requirement to perform eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3444 starts eCall inactivity procedure.
Expiry of timer T3445 starts eCall inactivity procedure.
